capri_data/2017/environment/manure_pool_.note: The haul cost is fixed at CAPRI's 0.18 EUR/t/km base value. CAPRI inflates it to the simulation year by p_infl (1.019 per year), so the model's manure trade costs between pools are lower than CAPRI's at 2030.

capri_data/2017/feed/feed_ration_2017.js.note: In 986 of 2,407 region-animal records, the base ration's dry matter falls outside the file's DMIN-DMAX range (worst: HR000000 broilers 2.4x DMAX). The ration model widens the DM bounds, and lowers the energy and protein requirements, to fit the base ration (CAPRI's p_trimFeed). So the file's requirements are not what binds at calibration.

capri_data/2017/supply/young_animals_201.note: This is the default young-animal table. It pools male and female calves and male and female young cattle into one balance each, where CAPRI clears them per sex. The pooled value per head is the unweighted mean of the two sexes' national unit values (e.g. Spain young cattle 1019.7 = (1075.0 + 964.4)/2).
